title: 第十九章 虎入羊群星陨长剑第二十章 进阶剑法骑士呼吸法
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 克拉森不在，这么多学生都在他剑室里闹事。
她闭关了这么久，这正好是一个装逼的大好机会。
“活动？”这些侍童听到这话，却是有些不知所措。
这伊芙的意思，这是要动手？
“伊芙小姐，您什么意思。”罗格语气一下子软了下来，显得十分恭敬。
一直以来，不少骑士侍童都因为伊芙的美貌和天赋偷偷关注她，也包括这个罗格。
伊芙紧了紧手上的护手，嘴角勾起一丝笑意，“来，所有人全力攻击我。谁能碰到我的身体，这把剑就归谁。”
她指了指悬在腰上的银色长剑。
这把长剑是伊芙十岁生日时，拉福林送给她的生日礼物，名为星陨。
剑长近一米，银色剑鞘上浮刻的数条流纹。
剑刃尾端的银色护手朝尾端收窄，宛如流星曳尾。
传闻这把剑是以陨铁为原料，请丹伦王国的工匠花费数月锻铸而成。
单单这一把剑就值十枚金币。
说着，伊芙从边上取下一条擦汗巾，系在了自己的眼上。
在场几十个侍童你看看我，我看看你，都不知道这个伊芙是想干什么。
他们中不少都听说过她打败克拉森的消息。
但是都是传闻，他们都没有亲眼见伊芙出手过。
一些侍童看着伊芙取下佩剑，开始蠢蠢欲动。
就算是这个伊芙再强，几十个人打一个，她还蒙着眼，难不成一起上，还能碰都碰不到。
骑士以诚实为准则，既然她说了这句话，那么便必须言出必行。
想着，罗格等几个资历较深的侍童互相看了一眼，便朝着伊芙的方向慢慢靠近了过去，“那伊芙小姐，我们可要得罪了。”
“来，我都把眼睛系上了，还这么畏畏缩缩的？”而且更加嚣张的是，此时的伊芙取下腰间佩剑，朝后狠狠一甩。
森！
星陨长剑自剑鞘飞出。
噌的一声，插在了后方岩墙之上。
三分之一的剑刃刺进岩体之中，剑柄剧烈震颤嗡嗡作响。
伊芙拿着银色剑鞘，朝着面前众人勾了勾手指。
“上！”为首的罗格一个箭步逼近，手中的铁剑对准伊芙的右肩便是狠狠一刺。
他可没想过打倒伊芙。
只要碰到对方的身体便算是赢。
所有剑法之中，刺击最为直接，也最适合突袭。
但就在罗格出剑的一瞬间，伊芙双耳一动，就像是感知到了什么。
剑尖逼近的瞬间，她后退半步，一个侧身轻松闪过刺击。
content_en:
Klassen was away, so many students were making trouble in his sword room.
She has been in seclusion for so long, and this is a great opportunity to show off.
"Activity?" When these servants heard this, they were a little at a loss.
Does Eve mean to take action?
"Miss Eve, what do you mean?" Rogge's tone suddenly softened and he looked very respectful.
For a long time, many knight servants have secretly paid attention to Eve because of her beauty and talent, including this Rogge.
Eve tightened the gauntlet on her hand, with a smile on her lips, "Come on, everyone attacks me with all their strength. Whoever can touch my body will get this sword."
She pointed to the silver sword hanging on her waist.
This long sword was a birthday gift given to Eve by Laughlin on her tenth birthday, named Starfall.
The sword is nearly one meter long, with several flowing lines embossed on the silver scabbard.
The silver guard at the end of the blade narrows toward the end, like a meteor trailing behind.
It is rumored that this sword is made of meteorite iron and requires craftsmen from the Kingdom of Danlun to spend several months forging it.
This sword alone is worth ten gold coins.
As she spoke, Eve took a sweat towel from the side and tied it around her eyes.
The dozens of waiters present looked at me and I looked at you, but they all had no idea what this Eve wanted to do.
Many of them had heard about her defeat of Klassen.
But these were all rumors, and none of them had ever seen Eve take action with their own eyes.
Some of the waiters watched Eve take off her sword and started to move.
No matter how strong this Eve is, if dozens of people hit one of them, she is still blindfolded. Is it possible that they can't even touch her if they fight together?
The knight takes honesty as her criterion, and since she said this, she must keep her word.
Thinking about this, Rogge and several more senior waiters glanced at each other, and then slowly approached Eve, "Then Miss Eve, we are going to offend you."
"Come on, I've tied my eyes, and you're still so timid?" What's even more arrogant is that at this time, Eve took off the sword from her waist and swung it back.
Sen!
The Star Meteor sword flew out from its scabbard.
With a bang, it was inserted into the rock wall behind.
One-third of the sword blade penetrated into the rock mass, and the hilt vibrated violently and buzzed.
Eve held the silver scabbard and raised her fingers at the people in front of her.
"Come on!" Rogge, the leader, approached with a lunge. He aimed the iron sword in his hand and stabbed Eve hard on her right shoulder.
He had no intention of defeating Eve.
As long as you touch the opponent's body, you win.
Among all sword techniques, stabbing is the most direct and most suitable for surprise attacks.
But the moment Rogge drew his sword, Eve's ears twitched, as if she sensed something.
The moment the sword tip approached, she took half a step back and turned sideways to easily dodge the thrust.
title_en: Chapter 19: Tigers among Sheep, Starfall Sword, Chapter 20: Advanced Sword Skills, Knight Breathing Techniques
